name: Assassin Poisoner
description: A cunning scoundrel skilled in both poisons and ambushing.

abilities.name: Grindletooth Venom
abilities.description: Targets who mark HP from the Assassin’s attacks are Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

abilities.name: Out of Nowhere
abilities.description: The Assassin has advantage on attacks if they are Hidden.

abilities.name: Fumigation
abilities.description: Drop a smoke bomb that fills the air within Close range with smoke, Dizzying all targets in this area. Dizzied targets have disadvantage on their next action roll, then clear the condition.
